sun.font

接口 FontManagerForSGE

  • 所有超级接口:
    FontManager
    所有已知实现类:
    SunFontManager, Win32FontManager

    public interface FontManagerForSGE
extends FontManager
    This is an extension of the FontManager interface which has to be implemented on systems that want to use SunGraphicsEnvironment. It adds a couple of methods that are only required by SGE. Graphics implementations that use their own GraphicsEnvironment are not required to implement this and can use plain FontManager instead.
